tiers.name: Workshop
tiers.desc: Teach a real class on how to build your project!

tiers.name: Service
tiers.desc: Install or implement your project in a real world location

tiers.name: Digital Citizen Post
tiers.desc: Write a article and post a photo about your pr0ject.

tiers.name: Interviews
tiers.desc: Interview people to understand who they are, what they do, why, and in what environment

tiers.name: Field Research
tiers.desc: Visit real world locations and record data on your users

tiers.name: Empowered Searcher
tiers.desc: Find the history of your audience to understand their culture and environment

tiers.name: User Stories
tiers.desc: Write or record stories of people having problems that you want to address, using an AGILE format

tiers.name: Roleplay
tiers.desc: Using simple props, express your insights into the situations and needs of your subjects

tiers.name: Mind Map
tiers.desc: Create a wall size map, showing people, problems, and solutions

tiers.name: Sketching
tiers.desc: Drawing rough drafts of  solutions you think of; only good enough  to convey general meanings.

tiers.name: Story Boarding
tiers.desc: Create a comic book illustrating solutions you would like your subjects to have

tiers.name: Brain Storm
tiers.desc: Discuss and record 5-10 ideas for designs, from typical to wild.

tiers.name: Work Plan
tiers.desc: From setup and cleanup tasklists, DT boards, or even full business plans, create a plan!

tiers.name: Physical Prototype
tiers.desc: Create a model of your design (skill ideas below). Prototypes are not meant to be fully functional, but rather to show some of your ideas in a physical form.

tiers.name: Digital Prototype
tiers.desc: Create a digital model of your design. Show your ideas in visual form instead of relying on live communication to express details.

tiers.name: Gather Feedback
tiers.desc: Get constructive feedback from others, via a presentation, sharing experience, or series of demonstrations

tiers.name: Reflection
tiers.desc: To better understand others, reflect upon your own purpose, biases, viewpoint, and goals in an essay.

tiers.name: Beta Test
tiers.desc: Use your prototype in a controlled situation, but with real users and environments

tiers.name: Hand Tools
tiers.desc: Hand drills, hand saws, screw drivers, pliers… and use them on wood alongside other materials!

tiers.name: Block Circuits
tiers.desc: Build a guided project, open project, and solo invention using Little Bits or similar

tiers.name: Card Craft
tiers.desc: Manipulating cardboard, foam core, and card stock is a core prototyping skill! Start simple, and keep adding projects (forever)

tiers.name: Stitch Craft
tiers.desc: Measure, outline, cut, sew, dye and print onto fabric to create softgoods!

tiers.name: Power Carpentry
tiers.desc: Create simple projects using electric tools! Drills, sanders, saws? Be careful!

tiers.name: Power Stitch Craft
tiers.desc: Electric sewing machines are fun! Make tool belts, pillow, etc

tiers.name: Electro Craft
tiers.desc: Solder wires, use heat guns, and power supplies while making projects

tiers.name: Metal Working
tiers.desc: Welding, cutting, melting and manipulating metals!

tiers.name: Simple Printers
tiers.desc: Give students control! Large scale, tiled, new media. Responsible and effective use of this tool is where to start.

tiers.name: Laser Cutter
tiers.desc: Start off downloading premade design files and using the machine, later design your own!

tiers.name: 3D Printer
tiers.desc: Start off downloading premade design files and using the machine, later design your own!

tiers.name: CNC Drill
tiers.desc: Utilize computer-controlled drilling machines to create precise and complex holes and shapes in materials like wood and metal

tiers.name: Simple PCBs
tiers.desc: voice recorder beatbox, electronic sythesizer, BIY arduino board

tiers.name: Microprocessors
tiers.desc: microbit, arduino, rasberry pi, jet nano, edison

tiers.name: Electronic Sensors
tiers.desc: Light, motion, and sound to start, more sensors possible

tiers.name: Breadboards
tiers.desc: Custom circuit design

tiers.name: Vector Artwork
tiers.desc: Use 2D vector editing programs to create designs including art, infographics, and design elements.

tiers.name: 3D Modeling
tiers.desc: 3D drawing of a physical model, using measurements

tiers.name: Videography
tiers.desc: Shoot a video to communicate something creatively

tiers.name: Hacking
tiers.desc: Download and modify programs or media

tiers.name: App Design
tiers.desc: Design a game or application

tiers.name: Robotics Coding
tiers.desc: Use sensors and actuators to create cars, robots, machines

tiers.name: iOT App Design
tiers.desc: Design a game or application that sends and receives data over the internet
